Class CashierApp.Repo

java.lang.Object
frontend.CashierApp.Repo
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
Enclosing class:
CashierApp
static class CashierApp.Repo extends Object implements AutoCloseable
Repository encapsulating DB access for cashier flows. Uses a single connection and provides query/update helpers. AutoCloseable to allow try-with-resources.

    • saveTicket

      long saveTicket(CashierApp.Ticket ticket, long employeeId, String paymentType) throws SQLException
      Save an entire ticket (order + combos + combo items + payment) and decrement inventory accordingly. Returns the created order id, or -1 if insufficient inventory.
      Parameters:
      ticket - the in-memory representation of the order
      employeeId - the employee placing the order
      paymentType - payment type string
      Returns:
      new order id, or -1 if stock is insufficient (no DB side effects kept)
      Throws:
      SQLException - on database error
